examNameMr: विशेष लेखापरक्षक, महाराष्ट्र सहकार सेवा, सहकारी संस्था, गट-ब
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

papers.paperTitle: Special Auditor, Maharashtra Co-operative Services, Co-op Societies, Group – B Screening Test
papers.paperTitleMr: विशेष लेखापरक्षक, महाराष्ट्र सहकार सेवा, सहकारी संस्था, गट-ब चाचणी परीक्षा

topics: A) Financial Accounting :
Accounting as a financial information system
Accounting Standards in India and international accounting standards (only outlines)
Final Accounts.
Depreciation accounting, Depreciation policies as per accounting standard.
Accounts of non-trading institution.
Partnership accounts.
Advanced problems of company accounts.
Amalgamation, absorption and reconstruction of companies.
Valuation of shares and goodwill.
Consolidated books of holding company with one subsidiary only.
B) Cost Accounting :
Nature and functions of cost accounting
Accountancy for material, labour and overheads
Job costing and Contract costing
Process costing
Marginal Costing
Techniques of segregating semi-variable costs into fixed and variable costs
Cost-volume-profit relationship
Aid to decision making including pricing decisions, shutdown etc.
Techniques of cost control and cost reduction
Costing of joint and by production. Reconciliation of cost and financial accounts
Budgetary control, flexible budgets
Standard costing and variance analysis.
Responsibility accounting, investment, profit and cost centres.
Considerations for commencing an Audit
Audit of cash transactions, expenses, incomes, purchases, sales.
Internal check system.
Valuation and verification of assets with special reference to fixed assets, stocks and debts.
Verification of liabilities
Audit of limited companies: appointment, removal, powers, duties and liabilities of company auditor, significance of ‘true and fair’, MAOCARO report.
Auditor’s report: Standard and qualified.
Special points in the audit of different organizations like clubs, hospitals, colleges, charitable institutes
Investigations of fraudulent activities
Audit Approach - EDP and mechanical systems
Social Auditing
Financial Analysis as a diagnostic tool.
Concepts of Valuation - Valuation of firm's Fixed Income, Securities and Common Stocks.
Dividend and Retention Policy - Residual Theory - Dividend Policy - Other Models - Actual Practices.
Capital Structure - Leverages - Significance of Leverages - Theories of Capital Structure with special reference to Modigliani and Miller approach. Planning the Capital Structure of a Company
EBIT-EPS Analysis, Cash-flow ability to service debt, Capital Structure Ratios, other methods, receivable agency
Provisions of Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act, 1960

topics: Mathematics - Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, Decimal, Fraction, Average.
General History of India - 1857 to 1947, Geography, Current Affairs and Polity in respect of Maharashtra.
General Science - Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Botany, Hygiene.
